problem_statement: The timer API must provide a flag TIM_FLAG_SET_STOPPED that can be passed to timer_set_periodic(). When TIM_FLAG_SET_STOPPED is set, timer_set_periodic() must configure the requested periodic alarm but leave the timer stopped, so the configured callback is not invoked while the timer remains stopped. The flag must work when combined with other timer flags.

verification.reason: The problem statement clearly specifies the flag name (TIM_FLAG_SET_STOPPED), the function it applies to (timer_set_periodic), the expected behavior (timer left stopped, callback not invoked), and that it must work combined with other flags. The hidden test only verifies these exact behaviors using standard APIs already present in the repository (timer_init, timer_set_periodic, timer_stop, TIMER_CYCL, timer_hz), all of which are either named in the statement or discoverable from the existing codebase.
